- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.

subtitles.zh: 听说你喜欢边走边聊。是的。
subtitles.en: I hear you love walking talks. Yes.

subtitles.zh: 因为我们坐得太久了。而且我们公司就在公园旁边。
subtitles.en: Because we sit too much. Yeah, and also our company is next to the park.

subtitles.zh: 所以很棒。这里是不是整天都在聊AI？
subtitles.en: So it's great. Is it all AI talk all the time here?

subtitles.zh: 不知道，别人聊什么。但我一直聊AI。
subtitles.en: I don't know. Other people's talk. But I talk AI all the time.

subtitles.zh: 但这是我唯一懂的。李飞飞是计算机视觉领域的巨擘。
subtitles.en: But that's the only thing I know. Feifei Lee is a giant in the field of computer vision.

subtitles.zh: 这是AI的一个分支，专门教机器看懂图像。
subtitles.en: A branch of AI dedicated to teaching machines to see.

subtitles.zh: 她通过ImageNet取得突破，这个视觉库点燃了现代AI革命，为她赢得了“AI教母”的称号。
subtitles.en: She made a breakthrough with ImageNet, a visual library that sparked the modern AI revolution, earning her the title, Godmother of AI.

subtitles.zh: 此后她一直是AI领域的先驱，担任斯坦福教授、谷歌高管、美国总统顾问，并坚定倡导AI服务人类。
subtitles.en: And she's been a pioneer at AI Center ever since, as a Stanford professor, a Google executive, an advisor to US presidents, and a relentless advocate for AI that serves people.

subtitles.zh: 我觉得AI领袖们对赋能人类谈得不够多。
subtitles.en: I feel the leaders of AI are not talking enough about empowering humanity.

subtitles.zh: 他们谈得太多的是取代人类、取代工作。
subtitles.en: They're talking too much about replacing humanity, replacing jobs.

subtitles.zh: 如今，她又将初创公司联合创始人的头衔加进了自己耀眼的履历。
subtitles.en: Now, she's adding startup co-founder to her star resume.

subtitles.zh: 经营自己的公司是什么感觉？我感觉自己像一只猛虎。
subtitles.en: What's it like running your own shop? I feel like a tiger wall.

subtitles.zh: 当AI界其他人都专注于像ChatGPT和Claude这样的大型语言模型时，李飞飞押注的是一个新领域——世界模型。
subtitles.en: While the rest of the AI world doubles down on large language models like ChatGPT and Claude, Lee is betting on a new frontier, world models.

subtitles.zh: 她正在构建的AI旨在预测现实世界中接下来会发生什么，而不仅仅是句子中的下一个词。
subtitles.en: She's building AI that aims to predict what happens next in the real world, not just the next word in a sentence.

subtitles.zh: 那么，世界模型最终能做什么是LLM永远做不到的？
subtitles.en: So what can world models do ultimately that LLMs will never be able to?

subtitles.zh: 文字能灭火吗？文字能煎蛋卷吗？
subtitles.en: Can words put down fires? Can words cook an omelette?
